subject: Trial hosting & acceptance plan — hosting options and security follow-ups
messages:
From: Selena Ortiz <selena@amplihealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Sato <tom@amplihealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from demo - trial scope & questions

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Tom and I had a quick sync after and wanted to capture the things that matter to us for a short POC/trial so we can get internal sign-off. High level asks: 

- Success criteria:
  - Latency: p95 end-to-end < 350ms for 2k token average prompt
  - Throughput: sustain 80 concurrent requests for a 5-minute sustained window
  - Output quality: fidelity on our standard test set (we'll share prompts)
  - Data handling: ability to guarantee no model retraining from our data and clear retention controls
- Hosting options: we need an option that can be PHI-safe (VPC/connectivity) but are open to starting with a hosted trial if that speeds us up
- Security: provide SOC 2 evidence and network peering guidance

Can you share a concise plan, recommended hosting approach, and timeline? If helpful, we can sign an NDA and push the security questionnaire.

Thanks,
Selena
Selena Ortiz
Head of ML Platforms, AmpliHealth

--
Attachment: security-request-20261013.pdf (customer security questionnaire)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Selena Ortiz <selena@amplihealth.com>, Tom Sato <tom@amplihealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo - trial scope & questions

Hi Selena / Tom — great to hear the internal priorities. Re: next steps I put together a brief trial plan and recommended path: attached (trial-plan_v1.pdf). Summary below.

On Wed, Oct 14, 2026 at 09:12 AM Selena Ortiz <selena@amplihealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo earlier...

Recommended approach (concise):
- Start with Redwood Hosted trial for rapid on-ramp (2–3 days to spin up), run initial quality + latency baselines with your prompts.
- Parallel: provision a Dedicated Sandbox for throughput and sustained-load tests (1–2 business days to reserve after agreement). Dedicated gives predictable GPUs and isolates quota for the trial.
- Optional: VPC Trial for PHI/production validation — we recommend this only after the sandbox passes acceptance gates due to onboarding time and network setup (1–2 weeks).

Suggested success criteria (proposed, please confirm):
- Latency: p95 < 300ms on 2k avg prompt in Dedicated Sandbox (measured with our tracer)
- Throughput: 100 sustained rps for 5 minutes without errors in Dedicated Sandbox
- Quality: pass your evaluation set with <5% regression vs baseline prompts
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report provided; VPC trial requires completed security questionnaire + IP allowlist
- Cost guardrail: estimated tokens cost under $X/day (we'll provide numbers once we have usage pattern)

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0: Confirm acceptance criteria and hosting choice (you)
- Week 1: Hosted trial + baseline quality run (R: Logan)
- Week 2: Dedicated Sandbox provisioning & throughput tests (R: Marissa)
- Week 3: Iterate on prompts, optional VPC prep if PHI path chosen (R: Marissa + Infra)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the acceptance criteria above (or paste your version).
2) Tell us which hosting option to start with (Hosted only, Hosted + Dedicated Sandbox, or VPC start).
3) Share the security questionnaire or NDA (we can return SOC2 evidence immediately once the NDA is in place).

Attachment: trial-plan_v1.pdf (2 pages)

I'll hold a 30-min kickoff slot on Fri if you'd like to triage the remaining questions.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo - trial scope & questions (internal)

Looping in operational items from infra perspective — short notes: 

- For the throughput numbers Selena asked for, Dedicated Sandbox is the most reliable way to test sustained rps without noisy neighbors. We should size for 2x expected load to get headroom.
- Measure: p95 token latency (end-to-end) and GPU utilization; capture cost per 10k tokens for comparison.
- Owner for Dedicated sandbox provisioning and VPC setup: Marissa (will coordinate cloud quotas and peering).
- If they want to start with Hosted only, add a 24–48 hour window to move to Dedicated once baseline is OK.

I'll add a short ops checklist to the drive and tag Marissa.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Selena Ortiz <selena@amplihealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Sato <tom@amplihealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T10:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo - trial scope & questions

Thanks Logan, Ben — this is helpful. Quick answers from our side: 

- We'd like to start with Hosted + Dedicated Sandbox in parallel. Hosted for quick quality validation; Dedicated for throughput and latency certification.
- We'll need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short answers spreadsheet for our security team (attached initial questionnaire).
- Timeline looks good; target for internal approval is two weeks if we can get the SOC evidence and the sandbox provisioning estimate.

Can you map owners + dates for the milestones and confirm what level of network info we'll need if we later push for a VPC trial?

Attachment: security-request-20261013.pdf (AmpliHealth security questionnaire)

Best,
Selena
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Selena Ortiz <selena@amplihealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo - trial scope & questions — ops checklist & owners

Hi Selena / Logan / Ben — thanks for confirming. I pulled together a short ops checklist and ownership map (attached). Key items and owners below: 

- Week 0 (today): Confirm acceptance criteria + sign-off (R: Selena) — due 2026-10-21
- Week 1 (hosted baseline): Logan runs quality baseline against your prompts, shares results (R: Logan) — due 2026-10-23
- Week 1 (sandbox provisioning): Marissa to reserve Dedicated Sandbox instance and provide estimated capacity and cost (R: Marissa) — due 2026-10-24
- Week 2 (throughput tests): Ben to run sustained load test and provide p95/p99 and GPU metrics (R: Ben) — due 2026-10-30
- Security gate: Redwood to share SOC 2 report + completed answers to questionnaire (R: Logan) — SOC doc provided on NDA; questionnaire answers by 2026-10-22
- VPC prep (optional): prerequisite is completed questionnaire + IP allowlist + network peering window (R: Marissa + Infra) — estimate 7–10 business days once started

Acceptance gates (explicit):
- p95 latency < 300ms in Dedicated Sandbox on your evaluation set
- Sustained 100 rps for 5 minutes without errors
- Quality regression <5% vs your baseline
- Security questionnaire completed and SOC2 evidence received

Attachments: vpc-connection-checklist.xlsx (connectivity items and ports), trial-plan_v1.pdf (earlier), security-request-20261013.pdf (from AmpliHealth)

Please confirm owners and dates; I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Thu 2026-10-21 or Fri 2026-10-22 depending on your availability. Once we have confirmation I'll open the HubSpot deal task and push the DocuSign plan for signature.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
